item.title: Comprehensive Solutions for ECG Connector and Cable Assemblies
item.description:
11P Clamshell ECG Connector with Cable Assembly
#

The 11P Clamshell ECG connector with cable assembly is designed to meet the demanding requirements of medical applications. This solution combines precision plastic injection components with reliable cable assembly, ensuring both durability and performance in clinical environments.

item.title: Precision Solutions for Custom Injection Molding
item.description:
Precision Solutions for Custom Injection Molding
#

Cambus serves as a one-stop source for precision plastic molds and injection parts, with a focus on delivering custom injection molding solutions for industries such as medical, electronics, automation, and military sectors.

item.title: Expertise in Custom Medical Device Components and Solutions
item.description:
Precision and Innovation in Medical Component Manufacturing
#

Cambus Corporation brings over 25 years of experience to the medical device industry, specializing in the development and production of custom medical components. Our expertise encompasses a wide range of solutions, from ECG cable assemblies and medical connectors to advanced plastic injection molding and comprehensive outsourcing services.
